model.name: Sprint selection updates the detail drawer
model.description: Selecting/clicking a SPRINT node in the traceability tree updates the detail drawer to show THAT sprint's details. The selection->drawer binding works for ALL tree node types (sprint/task/etc), always showing the selected unit's details. THE BUG: selecting a sprint did NOT change the drawer content.
model.tronQuote: > TRON 2026-07-13: clicking a sprint node must update the detail drawer to that sprint details - currently selecting a sprint does NOT change the drawer.

discoverySource.note: S30 traceability-tree bug. Bugs FIXED + deployed v0.7.11 BEFORE the req = #126 slip; chain completed scenario-first retroactively.

model.crossRefNote: S30 traceability-tree family (R30.1). R30.2 eager-count reuses R26.4 structure-eager-payload-lazy; R30.3 selection->drawer ties R25.4/R27.8.
